author: ETA PRIME
description:
Why wait for the official Steam Machine when you can have a living room gaming PC TODAY?

The Minisforum HX77G might be the closest thing to a Steam Machine you can buy right now — dedicated RX 6600M GPU, Ryzen 7 7735HS, and it runs Bazzite (the best SteamOS alternative) right out of the box. I'll show you how to set it up, upgrade the storage, and then run it through a full 1440p and 4K gaming benchmark across Cyberpunk 2077, Forza Horizon 6, Doom: The Dark Ages, and Crimson Desert.
